SELECT TM.MEMBER_ID, TM.COMPANY_ID, TC.COMPANY_NM, TMD.MEMBER_NM, TM.USE_YN, TM.AUTH_CD, TO_CHAR(TM.REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DT FROM TM_MEMBER TM, TM_MEMBER_DT TMD, TM_COMPANY TC WHERE TM.MEMBER_ID = TMD.MEMBER_ID AND TM.COMPANY_ID = TC.COMPANY_ID
AND TM.COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID}
AND TM.MEMBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{MEMBER_ID} || '%'
ORDER BY TM.COMPANY_ID, TM.MEMBER_ID

SELECT COMPANY_ID, BRANCH_ID, SANGSA_ID, SANGSA_NM, BIZ_NO, POST_NO, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DT, TEL_NO, MPHONE_NO, NEWCAR_YN, MORTREG_YN, MORTERS_YN, TRNSNAME_YN, PAYMENT_ME, USE_YN, INS_USER, TO_CHAR(INS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS INS_DATE, UPD_USER, TO_CHAR(UPD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPD_DATE, REG_GB, REG_NO FROM TM_SANGSA WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID} AND NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
AND BRANCH_ID = #{BRANCH_ID}
AND ( TO_CHAR(SANGSA_ID) LIKE '%' || #{KEYWORD} || '%' OR SANGSA_NM LIKE '%' || #{KEYWORD} || '%' )
AND ( TO_CHAR(SANGSA_ID) LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_KEYWORD} || '%' OR SANGSA_NM LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_KEYWORD} || '%' )
ORDER BY BRANCH_ID, CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TO_CHAR(SANGSA_ID), '^[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(SANGSA_ID) ELSE 999999 END, TO_CHAR(SANGSA_ID)

SELECT COMPANY_ID, BRANCH_ID, SANGSA_ID, SANGSA_NM, BIZ_NO, POST_NO, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DT, TEL_NO, MPHONE_NO, NEWCAR_YN, MORTREG_YN, MORTERS_YN, TRNSNAME_YN, PAYMENT_ME, USE_YN, INS_USER, TO_CHAR(INS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS INS_DATE, UPD_USER, TO_CHAR(UPD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPD_DATE, REG_GB, REG_NO FROM TM_SANGSA WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID} AND BRANCH_ID = #{BRANCH_ID} AND SANGSA_ID = #{SANGSA_ID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TM_SANGSA ( COMPANY_ID, BRANCH_ID, SANGSA_ID, SANGSA_NM, USE_YN, INS_DATE ) VALUES ( #{COMPANY_ID}, #{BRANCH_ID}, #{SANGSA_ID}, #{SANGSA_NM}, 'Y', SYSDATE )
